```{python}
#| tags: [setup]
import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.abspath("."))
from _pcpkg import *  # noqa: F401,F403
import doe_report as D
import tables as T          # complex tables: merged cells, footnotes (T.<builder>(...).show())
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import scipy.stats as sstat
import itertools

DOC = "INV-001"
UO = None
# The investigation judged every NOR as it stood when it closed: the characterized NOR, before
# PCR-005 and PCR-006 Version 2.0 changed NORs (the protein load NOR of Protein A, and the NORs and
# set-points of low-pH viral inactivation). Every NOR-based value below is computed inside this
# context; it is closed at the end of the setup chunk, where the Version 2.0 changes are classified.
_CN = D.characterized_nor()
_CN.__enter__()
# Every model value below is the full quadratic model of the planned runs, the model Version 1.0
# fitted, so that each comparison shows what the change of criteria moved and nothing else. INV-002
# later changed the models of some outputs (augmentation runs, refits); the reports give the final
# ranges. Closed with the NOR context at the end of the setup chunk.
_PF = D.planned_full_models()
_PF.__enter__()
UO_TITLE = "A-Mab Drug Substance"

# --- doc-local derived scalars (pulled from config -> model -> outputs; nothing typed) ---
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def f1(x): return f"{x:.1f}"
def md(df, widths=None):
    """Print a flat table with the cells exactly as formatted; widths are relative column widths."""
    cols = list(df.columns)
    out = ["| " + " | ".join(str(c) for c in cols) + " |"]
    w = widths or [max(3, len(str(c))) for c in cols]
    out.append("|" + "|".join("-" * int(x) for x in w) + "|")
    for row in df.astype(str).values.tolist():
        out.append("| " + " | ".join(row) + " |")
    print("\n".join(out))
def f2(x): return f"{x:.2f}"
def big(x): return f"{x:,.0f}"
def lc(s): return s if (len(s) > 1 and s[1].isupper()) or s.startswith("Protein A") else s[0].lower() + s[1:]
def attr(c): return T.ATTR_NAME[c].split(" (")[0]
def aname(c):
    """An attribute as prose names it: 'host cell protein', 'fragments', 'XMuLV clearance'."""
    return lc(attr(c).split(",")[0])
def sname(k): return lc(T.STEP_NAME[k])
_NW = ["no", "one", "two", "three", "four", "five", "six", "seven", "eight", "nine", "ten"]
def nw(n): return _NW[n] if 0 <= n < len(_NW) else str(n)
def unit(c): return T.ATTR_NAME[c].split("(")[-1].rstrip(")")
def _in(v, lo, hi, st):
    return (v >= lo) if st == "lower" else (v <= hi) if st == "upper" else (lo <= v <= hi)

OPENED, CLOSED = INV["opened"], INV["closed"]
REV1_DATE, REV2_DATE = REV1["effective"], REV2["effective"]
DOC_V, DOC_EFF = doc_version(DOC)
n_docs_v1 = len([d for d in DOC_REGISTRY if d not in INVESTIGATIONS])
# the investigation closed before PCMP-001 Version 2.0 took effect
assert CLOSED < REV2_DATE

# chronology: the studies Version 1.0 reported are every study in the chronology except those that
# produced only fragment results, which Version 1.0 did not report (the comparability study and the
# retests of retained samples), and those that started during the investigation (the further
# Protein A scale-down runs of the plan discrepancy PD-005-01, and the osmolality study of PD-003-01,
# which lies outside the scope of the investigation)
chron = csv("study_chronology.csv")
# the augmentation studies of INV-002 belong to that investigation, and studies that started after this
# investigation closed are not part of its record
chron_aug = chron[(chron["kind"] == "augmentation") & (chron["start"] <= CLOSED)]
chron = chron[(chron["kind"] != "augmentation") & (chron["start"] <= CLOSED)].reset_index(drop=True)
_st = chron.set_index("id")
# the Protein A discrepancy whose study ran within this investigation's record (the hold study PD-005-05
# was made after closure, during the Version 2.0 re-analysis, and is outside it)
_pd = [d for d in PLAN_DISCREPANCIES.get("PCR-005", [])
       if d.get("studies") and set(d["studies"]) <= set(chron["id"])]
assert len(_pd) == 1
pd_id, pd_studies = _pd[0]["id"], list(_pd[0]["studies"])
assert len(pd_studies) == 1
sdm2_id = pd_studies[0]
# the one other study that started after Version 1.0: the osmolality study of the bioreactor, outside the
# scope of the investigation, a discrepancy from its plan that its report records
_late = chron[chron["start"] > REV1_DATE]
_other = [s for s in _late["id"] if s not in pd_studies]
assert len(_other) == 1
osm_id = _other[0]
_pd3 = [(rid, d) for rid, ds in PLAN_DISCREPANCIES.items() for d in ds if osm_id in d.get("studies", [])]
assert len(_pd3) == 1
osm_rep, osm_pd = _pd3[0][0], _pd3[0][1]["id"]
osm_subj = lc(_pd3[0][1]["subject"].split(" at ")[0])          # "osmolality study"
osm_start, osm_step = _st.loc[osm_id, "start"], sname(_st.loc[osm_id, "step"])
assert _st.loc[osm_id, "step"] == "bioreactor"                # "the bioreactor report"
assert OPENED <= osm_start <= CLOSED                        # it started during the investigation
cmp_ids = list(chron[chron["kind"] == "comparability"]["id"])
ret_ids = list(chron[chron["kind"] == "retest"]["id"])
assert cmp_ids == ["S-CEX-FRC"] and len(ret_ids) == 2
chron_v1 = chron[~chron["id"].isin(cmp_ids + ret_ids + pd_studies + [osm_id])]
n_studies_v1 = len(chron_v1)
n_studies_excl = len(chron) - n_studies_v1
assert n_studies_excl == len(cmp_ids) + len(ret_ids) + len(pd_studies) + 1
# the augmentation studies of INV-002 that started before this investigation closed (left out of the count)
assert len(chron_aug) > 0 and bool((chron_aug["start"] >= OPENED).all())
assert bool((chron_v1["end"] < REV1_DATE).all())          # every Version 1.0 study closed before approval
assert bool((chron[chron["id"].isin(cmp_ids + ret_ids)]["end"] < REV1_DATE).all())
first_start, last_end = chron_v1["start"].min(), chron_v1["end"].max()
sdm2_start, sdm2_end = _st.loc[sdm2_id, ["start", "end"]]
assert OPENED <= sdm2_start and sdm2_end <= CLOSED          # S-PA-SDM2 ran during the investigation

# the supplementary scale-down runs: a discrepancy from the plan, not a deviation
_sdmq = csv("sdm_qualification.csv")
_sdmq = _sdmq[(_sdmq["step"] == "protein_a") & (_sdmq["scale"] == "scale-down")]
_sdm_planned_ids = [s for s in _sdmq["study"].unique() if s != sdm2_id]
n_sdm_planned = int(_sdmq["study"].isin(_sdm_planned_ids).sum())
n_sdm_sup = int((_sdmq["study"] == sdm2_id).sum())
sdm1_id = _sdm_planned_ids[0]
OFF_CI = int(round(100 * CFG.raw()["analytics"]["sdm"]["offset_ci"]))
# the offsets and the qualification themselves are computed at the end of this chunk, on the models
# that INV-002 corrective action CA3 selects (the models PCR-005 Version 2.0 uses)

frc_start, frc_end = _st.loc["S-CEX-FRC", "start"], _st.loc["S-CEX-FRC", "end"]
ret_start, ret_end = _st.loc["S-PA-RET", "start"], _st.loc["S-PA-RET", "end"]
aexr_start = _st.loc["S-AEX-SCR", "start"]
cexr_start, cexr_end = _st.loc["S-CEX-RSM", "start"], _st.loc["S-CEX-RSM", "end"]
assert cexr_start < AMD["date"] < cexr_end and aexr_start > AMD["date"] and ret_start > AMD["date"]

# Version 1.0 criteria
r1 = D.rev1_criteria()
n_r1 = len(r1)
n_r1_steps = r1["step_key"].nunique()
RV1 = CFG.raw()["rev1_ipc_limits"]
sigma = RV1["capability_alert_sigma"]
v_allow = RV1["viral_assay_allowance"]
_mg = r1.dropna(subset=["margin"])
n_margin = len(_mg)
m_lo, m_hi = _mg["margin"].min(), _mg["margin"].max()
n_capbased = int((r1["rule"] == "mean + 2.5 sd of capability").sum())
assert set(r1[r1["rule"] == "mean + 2.5 sd of capability"]["step_key"]) == {"bioreactor"}
n_viral_r1 = int(r1["cqa"].str.startswith("lrv").sum())
n_viral_req = int((r1["rule"] == "requirement - nominal of other steps").sum())
n_viral_claim = int(r1["rule"].str.startswith("nominal claim").sum())

def _r1(key, resp):
    return r1[(r1["step_key"] == key) & (r1["response"] == resp)].iloc[0]

pa_hcp = _r1("protein_a", "pool_hcp_ng_mg")
pa_hcp_crit, pa_hcp_margin = pa_hcp["high"], pa_hcp["margin"]
cex_agg = _r1("cex", "aggregate_out_pct")
cex_agg_crit, cex_agg_margin = cex_agg["high"], cex_agg["margin"]
_iac = D.iac_table()
def _ds(cqa, col):
    return _iac[_iac["cqa"] == cqa].iloc[0][col]
ds_hcp = _ds("hcp", "ds_high")
ds_agg = _ds("aggregates_hmw", "ds_high")
ds_acid_lo, ds_acid_hi = _ds("acidic_variants", "ds_low"), _ds("acidic_variants", "ds_high")
ds_frag = _ds("fragments_lmw", "ds_high")

# the Version 1.0 viral clearance criteria. At low-pH viral inactivation and anion exchange: the
# cumulative requirement less the single set-point values of the other two steps in the Version 1.0
# viral clearance summary (viral_clearance.csv). At virus filtration: the step's own value less the
# assay allowance. Neither uses the response surface models of Table 6.5.
_vcs = csv("viral_clearance.csv").set_index("step")
_VCOL = {"lrv_xmulv": "XMuLV", "lrv_mvm": "MVM"}
_VK = list(D.VIRAL_STEP_ROW)
assert _VK == ["viral_inactivation", "aex", "virus_filtration"]
vcs = {(k, c): float(_vcs.loc[D.VIRAL_STEP_ROW[k], col]) for k in _VK for c, col in _VCOL.items()}
vreq = {c: float(_ds(c, "ds_low")) for c in _VCOL}
for _, r in r1[r1["cqa"].isin(list(_VCOL))].iterrows():
    _own = vcs[(r["step_key"], r["cqa"])]
    _oth = sum(v for (k, c), v in vcs.items() if c == r["cqa"] and k != r["step_key"])
    _want = (vreq[r["cqa"]] - _oth) if r["rule"] == "requirement - nominal of other steps" else _own - v_allow
    assert abs(_want - r["low"]) < 0.005, (r["step_key"], r["cqa"], _want, r["low"])
assert vcs[("viral_inactivation", "lrv_mvm")] == 0 and vcs[("aex", "lrv_mvm")] > 0
vi_xm_r1 = _r1("viral_inactivation", "xmulv_lrf")["low"]
vcs_xm_txt = (f"{f2(vcs[('viral_inactivation', 'lrv_xmulv')])} log10 for low-pH viral inactivation, "
              f"{f2(vcs[('aex', 'lrv_xmulv')])} for anion exchange and "
              f"{f2(vcs[('virus_filtration', 'lrv_xmulv')])} for virus filtration")
vcs_mvm_txt = (f"{f2(vcs[('aex', 'lrv_mvm')])} log10 for anion exchange and "
               f"{f2(vcs[('virus_filtration', 'lrv_mvm')])} for virus filtration, and no clearance "
               "for low-pH viral inactivation")
vcs_example = (f"the cumulative requirement of {vreq['lrv_xmulv']:g} log10 less "
               f"{f2(vcs[('aex', 'lrv_xmulv')])} and {f2(vcs[('virus_filtration', 'lrv_xmulv')])}, "
               f"which is {f2(vi_xm_r1)} log10")

# §3.2: no part of the Protein A characterization range meets the drug-substance HCP criterion
_uo_pa = CFG.unit_op("protein_a")
_fpa = D.fit("protein_a", "rsm", "pool_hcp_ng_mg")["factors"]
_gpa = list(itertools.product(*[[_uo_pa.param(f).prange[0], _uo_pa.param(f).setpoint,
                                 _uo_pa.param(f).prange[1]] for f in _fpa]))
_ypa = D.predict("protein_a", "pool_hcp_ng_mg", natural={f: [g[i] for g in _gpa] for i, f in enumerate(_fpa)})
assert float(np.min(_ypa)) - D.sdm_offset("protein_a", "pool_hcp_ng_mg")["offset"] > ds_hcp

# F2: what each safety factor did at the set-point of its own step
def _setpoint_pred(key, resp):
    fs = D.rsm_factors(key)
    sp = {f: CFG.unit_op(key).param(f).setpoint for f in fs}
    return float(D.predict(key, resp, natural=sp)[0])

_rows = []
for _, r in _mg.iterrows():
    pred = _setpoint_pred(r["step_key"], r["response"])
    ceiling = r["high"] * r["margin"]
    _rows.append(dict(step=r["step_key"], cqa=r["cqa"], margin=r["margin"], crit=r["high"],
                      pred=pred, ceiling=ceiling, maxf=ceiling / pred))
margin_df = pd.DataFrame(_rows)
n_pass_sp = int((margin_df["pred"] <= margin_df["crit"]).sum())
assert n_pass_sp == n_margin                                  # the summary says every step passed
n_fail_uniform = int((margin_df["maxf"] < m_hi).sum())
margin_show = pd.DataFrame({
    "Step": [T.STEP_NAME[s] for s in margin_df["step"]],
    "Attribute": [T.ATTR_NAME[c] for c in margin_df["cqa"]],
    "Highest pool level": [T.num(x) for x in margin_df["ceiling"]],
    "Safety factor": [f1(x) for x in margin_df["margin"]],
    "Version 1.0 criterion": [f"≤ {T.num(x)}" for x in margin_df["crit"]],
    "Predicted at set-point": [T.num(x) for x in margin_df["pred"]],
    "Largest factor met at set-point": [f2(x) for x in margin_df["maxf"]],
})
# two-line headers; the first column's meaning goes in its note
margin_header = {"Highest pool level": "Highest pool\nlevel^a)^",
                 "Safety factor": "Safety\nfactor",
                 "Version 1.0 criterion": "Version 1.0\ncriterion",
                 "Predicted at set-point": "Predicted at\nset-point",
                 "Largest factor met at set-point": "Largest factor\nmet at set-point"}
margin_notes = [("a)", "The highest pool level that the nominal clearance of the downstream steps brings "
                       "within the drug-substance criterion. Nominal clearance is the clearance each "
                       "downstream step showed at its set-point in this campaign.")]

# F3: capability-based limits
# the simulation at the NOR as characterized, which Version 1.0 reported and this investigation judged
capdf = csv("capability_rev1.csv").set_index("key")
_cap_rows = []
for _, r in r1[r1["rule"] == "mean + 2.5 sd of capability"].iterrows():
    c = capdf.loc[r["cqa"]]
    _cap_rows.append([T.ATTR_NAME[r["cqa"]], f"{c['mean']:.2f}", f"{c['sd']:.3f}",
                      f"{c['mean'] + sigma * c['sd']:.2f}", f"{r['high']:.2f}",
                      T.crit(c["acc_low"], c["acc_high"], "two_sided")])
    assert f"{c['mean'] + sigma * c['sd']:.2f}" == f"{r['high']:.2f}"
cap_show = pd.DataFrame(_cap_rows, columns=[
    "Attribute", "Capability mean", "Capability SD", f"Mean + {sigma:g} SD",
    "Version 1.0 upper criterion", "Drug-substance criterion"])
exceed_pct = 100 * sstat.norm.sf(sigma)

# F4 and the capability change
acid = capdf.loc["acidic_variants"]
acid_cpu, acid_cpl, acid_cpk = acid["Cpu"], acid["Cpl"], acid["Cpk"]
acid_mean, acid_sd = acid["mean"], acid["sd"]
assert acid_cpl < acid_cpu and acid_cpk == acid_cpl          # the lower end governs
_v1keys = [k for k in capdf.index if k != "fragments_lmw"]
_v1cpk = pd.Series({k: (capdf.loc[k, "Cpu"] if k == "acidic_variants" else capdf.loc[k, "Cpk"])
                    for k in _v1keys})
v1_min_cpk, v1_min_key = _v1cpk.min(), _v1cpk.idxmin()
v1_min_name = aname(v1_min_key)
v2_min_cpk = float(capdf["Cpk"].min())
assert capdf["Cpk"].idxmin() == "acidic_variants"
poos = csv("p_oos_rev1.csv").set_index("key")
acid_noos, n_mc = int(poos.loc["acidic_variants", "n_oos"]), int(poos.loc["acidic_variants", "n"])
acid_ppm = poos.loc["acidic_variants", "ppm_normal"]
n_noos_other = int(poos.drop(index="acidic_variants")["n_oos"].sum())
assert acid_noos > 0
noos_phrase = (f"one batch in {n_mc:,}" if acid_noos == 1 else f"{acid_noos} batches in {n_mc:,}")
other_oos_phrase = ("No simulated batch falls outside the criterion of any other attribute."
                    if n_noos_other == 0 else
                    f"For the other attributes together, {n_noos_other} simulated batches fall outside their criteria.")

# F5: plan approval dates and equipment calibration against the execution windows
PCP_OF = {"PCP-003": "bioreactor", "PCP-004": "harvest", "PCP-005": "protein_a",
          "PCP-006": "viral_inactivation", "PCP-007": "cex", "PCP-008": "aex",
          "PCP-009": "virus_filtration", "PCP-010": "ufdf"}
_pl = []
for pid, key in PCP_OF.items():
    first = chron[chron["step"] == key]["start"].min()
    _pl.append([pid, T.STEP_NAME[key], PLAN_APPROVAL[pid], first, REV1_DATE])
assert all(r[2] < r[3] for r in _pl)                          # every plan approved before its studies
assert all(r[3] < r[4] for r in _pl)                          # every title-block date after the first study
# the title-block date is the same for every plan, so the table states it once, in its caption
assert len({r[4] for r in _pl}) == 1
plan_show = pd.DataFrame([r[:4] for r in _pl], columns=["Plan", "Step", "Approved", "First study started"])
pa_appr, pa_first = PLAN_APPROVAL["PCP-005"], chron[chron["step"] == "protein_a"]["start"].min()
pcmp_appr = PLAN_APPROVAL["PCMP-001"]

# the execution windows of the Version 1.0 studies on instrumented systems (the table lists no other)
cw = T.calibration_windows_data()
assert set(cw["Study"]) == set(chron_v1.dropna(subset=["equipment"])["id"])
n_cw_studies, n_cw_eq = len(cw), cw["Equipment"].nunique()
# the systems the Version 1.0 equipment tables recorded: those the Version 1.0 studies used
eq = equipment_df()
eq = eq[eq["Equipment"].isin(cw["Equipment"])]
n_eq = len(eq)
n_eq_before_rev1 = int((eq["Next calibration due"] < REV1_DATE).sum())
due_phrase = ("Every one of these due dates precedes the date in the title blocks."
              if n_eq_before_rev1 == n_eq else
              f"Of these due dates, {n_eq_before_rev1} precede the date in the title blocks.")
assert bool((cw["Execution end"] < cw["Next calibration due"]).all())   # no study ran out of calibration
_cwm = (pd.to_datetime(cw["Next calibration due"]) - pd.to_datetime(cw["Execution end"])).dt.days
_cwn = cw.loc[_cwm.idxmin()]
cw_near_study, cw_near_end, cw_near_due = _cwn["Study"], _cwn["Execution end"], _cwn["Next calibration due"]
cw_near_eq, cw_near_desc = _cwn["Equipment"], lc(_cwn["Description"])
cw_near_step = sname(_st.loc[cw_near_study, "step"])
cw_near_days = int(_cwm.min())

# F6: SEC against nrCE-SDS (S-CEX-FRC), sample means
cmp = csv("cex_fraction_comparability.csv").groupby("sample", sort=False)[
    ["lmw_sec_pct", "lmw_cesds_pct", "difference"]].mean()
d_pa, d_vi, d_load = (cmp.loc[s, "difference"] for s in ["Protein A pool", "VI pool", "CEX load"])
sec_pa, ce_pa = cmp.loc["Protein A pool", "lmw_sec_pct"], cmp.loc["Protein A pool", "lmw_cesds_pct"]
d_up_lo = min(d_pa, d_vi, d_load); d_up_hi = max(d_pa, d_vi, d_load)
d_dn_abs = cmp.loc[["CEX pool", "AEX pool"], "difference"].abs().max()
assert d_up_lo > 0 and d_dn_abs < d_up_lo
d_pa_share = 100 * d_pa / ce_pa

# Version 2.0 criteria and the verification
n_iac = len(_iac)
n_iac_ds = int((_iac["basis"] == "drug substance").sum())
n_iac_claim = int((_iac["basis"] == "platform claim").sum())
n_iac_back = n_iac - n_iac_ds - n_iac_claim
_is_t = _iac["tightened"].astype(str).eq("True")
_is_w = _iac["widened"].astype(str).eq("True")
n_tight, n_wid = int(_is_t.sum()), int(_is_w.sum())
_tt = _iac[_is_t]
tight_steps = " and ".join(sname(s) for s in _tt["step_key"])
assert set(_tt["cqa"]) == {"aggregates_hmw"}
_ww = _iac[_is_w]
_wl = [f"{aname(c)} at the {sname(s)} step" for s, c in zip(_ww["step_key"], _ww["cqa"])]
wid_list = ", ".join(_wl[:-1]) + " and " + _wl[-1] if len(_wl) > 1 else "".join(_wl)
ver = D.iac_verification()
_vt = ver[ver["met"].notna()]
n_ver = len(_vt)
n_ver_met = int((_vt["met"] == 1).sum())
n_ver_wsup = int(((_vt["met"] == 1) & (_vt["widening_supported"] == 1)).sum())
n_ver_nt = int(ver["met"].isna().sum())
assert n_ver - n_ver_met == 1                                 # "One assumption was not confirmed"
_vx = ver[ver["met"] == 0].iloc[0]
assert (_vx["step_key"], _vx["cqa"]) == ("cex", "aggregates_hmw")
cex_agg_assumed, cex_agg_nor, cex_agg_edge = _vx["assumed"], _vx["predicted_nor"], _vx["observed_edge"]
# a changed criterion moves only on the data of a step downstream of the one it judges
for _, r in _iac[_is_t | _is_w].iterrows():
    _dn = ver[(ver["step"] > r["step"]) & (ver["cqa"] == r["cqa"])
              & ((ver["met"] == 0) | (ver["widening_supported"] == 1))]
    assert len(_dn) > 0, (r["step_key"], r["cqa"])
vc = csv("iac_viral_cumulative.csv").set_index("cqa")
xm_sum, xm_req = vc.loc["lrv_xmulv", "claimed_sum"], vc.loc["lrv_xmulv", "required"]
mvm_sum, mvm_req = vc.loc["lrv_mvm", "claimed_sum"], vc.loc["lrv_mvm", "required"]
assert xm_sum >= xm_req and mvm_sum >= mvm_req
cex_ds_agg_v2 = D.iac_limit("cex", "aggregate_out_pct")[1]

# host cell protein at cation exchange and anion exchange, and the Protein A criterion they set
_vh = ver[(ver["step_key"] == "cex") & (ver["cqa"] == "hcp")].iloc[0]
_va = ver[(ver["step_key"] == "aex") & (ver["cqa"] == "hcp")].iloc[0]
cex_hcp_assumed, cex_hcp_edge, cex_hcp_nor = _vh["assumed"], _vh["observed_edge"], _vh["predicted_nor"]
cex_hcp_bound = _vh["predicted_nor_bound95"]
aex_hcp_assumed, aex_hcp_bound = _va["assumed"], _va["predicted_nor_bound95"]
MAX_GAP, LOF_ALPHA = THRESHOLDS["max_r2_minus_pred_r2"], THRESHOLDS["lof_alpha"]
# the bound that moves a criterion: the one-sided prediction bound of a single batch at the least
# favourable NOR combination (D.VERIFICATION_BOUND), never a confidence bound of the mean
VB = f"{100 * D.VERIFICATION_BOUND:g}"
# cation exchange: the prediction within the NOR confirms the platform value, but its single-batch bound
# does not beat it, so the platform value stands there and no criterion moves on it
assert cex_hcp_edge < cex_hcp_assumed < cex_hcp_nor and bool(_vh["met"])
assert str(_vh["widening_supported"]) == "False" and cex_hcp_bound < cex_hcp_assumed
# anion exchange: the single-batch bound beats the platform value on a model that passes the adequacy
# tests (the models INV-002 corrective action CA3 selects), so it replaced the platform value
aex_hcp_widened = str(_va["widening_supported"]) == "True"
assert aex_hcp_widened and aex_hcp_bound > aex_hcp_assumed and str(_va["model_adequate"]) == "True"
_better = ((_vt["assumption"] == "fold_min") & (_vt["predicted_nor_bound95"] > _vt["assumed"])) | \
          ((_vt["assumption"] == "add_max") & (_vt["predicted_nor_bound95"] < _vt["assumed"]))
_wsup = _vt["widening_supported"].astype(float).eq(1)
_met = _vt["met"].astype(float).eq(1)
assert int(_wsup.sum()) == n_ver_wsup
n_ver_better_inadequate = int((_better & _met & ~_wsup).sum())
# confirmed, but the single-batch bound is not better than the platform value: the platform value stands
n_ver_kept = int((_met & ~_better).sum())
assert n_ver_met == n_ver_wsup + n_ver_better_inadequate + n_ver_kept
# a bound better than the platform value on a model that is not adequate: the acidic variants of the
# low-pH design, whose results have no scatter, so the model fits them exactly and the adequacy criteria
# cannot be applied (owner, 2026-10-09). The platform value stands.
_vin = _vt[_better & _met & ~_wsup]
_vin_resp = {("viral_inactivation", "acidic_variants"): "acidic_variants"}
assert set(zip(_vin["step_key"], _vin["cqa"])) <= set(_vin_resp)
# "no scatter": every result at the same hold time is identical (asserted on the data, outside any
# Version 1.0 analysis context, which would force the full quadratic)
for _k, _c in zip(_vin["step_key"], _vin["cqa"]):
    _dd = csv(f"doe_{_k}_rsm.csv")
    assert (_dd.groupby("hold_time")[_vin_resp[(_k, _c)]].nunique() == 1).all()
vin_sentence = ("For the increase of acidic variants at low-pH viral inactivation the bound was also better, but "
                "the acidic-variant results of that design have no scatter. The model fits them exactly, so the "
                "lack-of-fit test and the model F-test cannot be applied, and the platform value stands."
                if n_ver_better_inadequate else "")
assert n_ver_better_inadequate == len(_vin) <= 1
_pah = _iac[(_iac["step_key"] == "protein_a") & (_iac["cqa"] == "hcp")].iloc[0]
pa_hcp_apriori, pa_hcp_v2 = _pah["iac_high_apriori"], _pah["iac_high"]
assert str(_pah["widened"]) == "True" and pa_hcp_v2 > pa_hcp_apriori > pa_hcp_crit
# the Protein A criterion is the drug-substance criterion carried back through the platform value at
# cation exchange and the single-batch bound at anion exchange
# (iac_verification.csv rounds the bound to four decimals, iac.csv keeps it whole)
assert abs(float(_pah["downstream_fold"]) / (cex_hcp_assumed * aex_hcp_bound) - 1) < 1e-4
# the cation exchange criterion for host cell protein: carried back through anion exchange alone
_ch = _iac[(_iac["step_key"] == "cex") & (_iac["cqa"] == "hcp")].iloc[0]
cex_hcp_apriori, cex_hcp_v2 = _ch["iac_high_apriori"], _ch["iac_high"]
assert abs(float(_ch["downstream_fold"]) / aex_hcp_bound - 1) < 1e-4 and str(_ch["widened"]) == "True"
assert abs(pa_hcp_v2 - ds_hcp * float(_pah["downstream_fold"])) < 1e-6 * pa_hcp_v2

# PAR (NOR) entries, Version 1.0 against Version 2.0, per report
PCR_OF = {"bioreactor": "PCR-003", "protein_a": "PCR-005", "viral_inactivation": "PCR-006",
          "cex": "PCR-007", "aex": "PCR-008", "virus_filtration": "PCR-009"}

def _span(s):
    try:
        a, b = str(s).split("–")
        return float(a), float(b)
    except ValueError:
        return None

def _par_changes(key):
    a, b = D.par_table_rev1(key), D.par_table(key)
    m = b.merge(a[["CQA", "Parameter", "PAR (NOR)"]], on=["CQA", "Parameter"], how="left",
                suffixes=("", "_v1"))
    return m

def _kind(old, new):
    if pd.isna(old):
        return "new"
    if str(new).startswith("none"):
        return "none"
    if str(old) == str(new):
        return "same"
    o, n = _span(old), _span(new)
    if o and n and n[0] <= o[0] and n[1] >= o[1]:
        return "wider"
    if o and n and n[0] >= o[0] and n[1] <= o[1]:
        return "narrower"
    return "shifted"

_allpar = []
for k in PCR_OF:
    m = _par_changes(k)
    m["step"] = k
    m["kind"] = [_kind(o, n) for o, n in zip(m["PAR (NOR)_v1"], m["PAR (NOR)"])]
    _allpar.append(m)
allpar = pd.concat(_allpar, ignore_index=True)
_ps = {k: {c: int((allpar[allpar["step"] == k]["kind"] == c).sum())
           for c in ["new", "same", "wider", "narrower", "shifted", "none"]} for k in PCR_OF}
par_show = pd.DataFrame([[PCR_OF[k], T.STEP_NAME[k], sum(v.values()) - v["new"], v["same"],
                          v["wider"], v["narrower"], v["shifted"], v["none"], v["new"]]
                         for k, v in _ps.items()],
                        columns=["Report", "Step", "In Version 1.0", "Unchanged",
                                 "Wider", "Narrower", "Moved", "No range", "New"])
for _c in ["Moved", "No range"]:
    if par_show[_c].sum() == 0:
        par_show = par_show.drop(columns=_c)
n_par_same = int((allpar["kind"] == "same").sum())
n_par_wider = int((allpar["kind"] == "wider").sum())
n_par_narrow = int((allpar["kind"] == "narrower").sum())
n_par_moved = int((allpar["kind"] == "shifted").sum())
n_par_none = int((allpar["kind"] == "none").sum())
n_par_new = int((allpar["kind"] == "new").sum())
n_par_v1 = int((allpar["kind"] != "new").sum())
n_par_changed = n_par_wider + n_par_narrow + n_par_moved + n_par_none
assert n_par_wider > n_par_changed / 2
for _o, _n in zip(*[allpar[allpar["kind"] == "shifted"][c] for c in ["PAR (NOR)_v1", "PAR (NOR)"]]):
    _a, _b = _span(_o), _span(_n)           # "moved": one end inward, the other outward
    assert (_b[0] < _a[0] and _b[1] < _a[1]) or (_b[0] > _a[0] and _b[1] > _a[1])
assert bool(allpar[allpar["kind"] == "none"]["PAR (NOR)"].str.contains("set-point").all())                         # "most of the changed ranges widened"
par_counts_phrase = (f"{n_par_wider} are wider in the re-analysis"
                     + f", {n_par_narrow} are narrower"
                     + (f", {n_par_moved} have moved" if n_par_moved else "")
                     + (f", {n_par_none} no longer give a range" if n_par_none else "")
                     + f" and {n_par_same} are unchanged")

# which Version 1.0 rule each wider range was judged against
_LBL2RESP = {}
for _, r in r1.iterrows():
    _LBL2RESP[(r["step_key"], D.RESP_LABEL[r["response"]])] = r["rule"]
def _v1rule(step, lbl):

_wd = allpar[allpar["kind"] == "wider"].copy()

_wb = _wd[_wd["step"] == "bioreactor"]

brx_wider_glycan = int((_wb["rule"] == "R2").sum())
assert set(_wb[_wb["rule"] == "R2"]["CQA"]) <= {"Afucosylation", "Galactosylation", "High mannose"}
brx_wider_agg = int(((_wb["rule"] == "R1") & _wb["CQA"].str.startswith("Aggregates")).sum())
assert brx_wider == brx_wider_glycan + brx_wider_agg
_wo = _wd[_wd["step"] != "bioreactor"]
n_wider_other = len(_wo)
n_wider_other_r1 = int((_wo["rule"] == "R1").sum())

n_wider_other_r4 = len(_wo4)

assert n_wider_other_r1 > n_wider_other / 2
assert set(_wo4["step"]) <= {"virus_filtration"}
assert set(zip(_wods["step"], _wods["CQA"])) <= {("protein_a", "Leached Protein A (ppm)")}
def _n_ranges(n): return f"{nw(n)} range" + ("" if n == 1 else "s")
_rest = []
if n_wider_other_ds:
    _rest.append(f"{_n_ranges(n_wider_other_ds)} for leached Protein A at the Protein A step, which "
                 "Version 1.0 judged against the drug-substance criterion itself,")
if n_wider_other_r4:

                 "(the fourth rule in §3.3) lay above the platform claim that replaced it")
wider_rest_phrase = ("The remaining wider ranges are " + " and ".join(_rest) + ".") if _rest else ""
for _, r in r1[r1["step_key"] == "virus_filtration"].iterrows():

def par_cell(key, cqa, param, rev):
    t = D.par_table_rev1(key) if rev == 1 else D.par_table(key)
    return t[(t["CQA"] == cqa) & (t["Parameter"] == param)].iloc[0]["PAR (NOR)"]

cex_load_v1 = par_cell("cex", "Aggregates (HMW, %)", "Protein load", 1)
cex_load_v2 = par_cell("cex", "Aggregates (HMW, %)", "Protein load", 2)

assert _span(cex_load_v1)[1] < cex_load_nor[1] <= _span(cex_load_v2)[1]
brx_gal_v1 = par_cell("bioreactor", "Galactosylation", CFG.unit_op("bioreactor").param("co2").name, 1)
brx_co2_nor = CFG.unit_op("bioreactor").param("co2").nor
brx_gal_v2 = par_cell("bioreactor", "Galactosylation", CFG.unit_op("bioreactor").param("co2").name, 2)
assert _span(brx_gal_v1)[0] > brx_co2_nor[0] >= _span(brx_gal_v2)[0]

# acidic variants at the bioreactor: the ranges that changed, and what constrains them
_ba = allpar[(allpar["step"] == "bioreactor") & (allpar["CQA"] == "Acidic variants")]
brx_acid_changed = int(_ba["kind"].isin(["wider", "narrower", "shifted", "none"]).sum())
brx_acid_wider = int((_ba["kind"] == "wider").sum())
brx_acid_narrow = int((_ba["kind"] == "narrower").sum())
brx_acid_moved = int((_ba["kind"] == "shifted").sum())
assert brx_acid_changed == _ps["bioreactor"]["narrower"] + _ps["bioreactor"]["shifted"]
_brx_r1 = r1[r1["step_key"] == "bioreactor"].set_index("response")
_brx_v2 = _iac[_iac["step_key"] == "bioreactor"].set_index("response")
_brx_tighter = [x for x in _brx_r1.index if _brx_v2.loc[x, "iac_high"] < _brx_r1.loc[x, "high"]
                or _brx_v2.loc[x, "iac_low"] > _brx_r1.loc[x, "low"]]
# the only stricter bioreactor limit is the acidic variant floor, which Version 1.0 did not apply

# judged against the upper limit alone, every acidic variant range would span the whole range
_ea = D.effective_acceptance
try:
    D.effective_acceptance = lambda k, r: ((lambda a: (a[0], a[1], "upper"))(_ea(k, r))
                                           if (k, r) == ("bioreactor", "acidic_variants") else _ea(k, r))
    for _f in D.rsm_factors("bioreactor"):

        _pr = CFG.unit_op("bioreactor").param(_f).prange
        assert _p is not None and abs(_p[0] - _pr[0]) < 1e-9 and abs(_p[1] - _pr[1]) < 1e-9
finally:
    D.effective_acceptance = _ea
brx_acid_phrase = (f"{nw(brx_acid_narrow)} narrowed, {nw(brx_acid_moved)} moved and "
                   + ("none widened" if brx_acid_wider == 0 else f"{nw(brx_acid_wider)} widened"))
_nw = allpar[allpar["kind"].isin(["narrower", "shifted", "none"])]
assert set(_nw["step"]) == {"bioreactor", "viral_inactivation", "aex"}
assert set(_nw[_nw["step"] == "bioreactor"]["CQA"]) == {"Acidic variants"}
assert set(_nw[_nw["step"] == "viral_inactivation"]["CQA"]) == {"XMuLV LRF (log₁₀)"}

# viral clearance ranges at low-pH viral inactivation and anion exchange
_vi = allpar[allpar["step"] == "viral_inactivation"]
_vix = _vi[_vi["CQA"].str.startswith("XMuLV")]
n_vi_factors = len(_vix)
n_vi_none = int((_vix["kind"] == "none").sum())
assert n_vi_none == _ps["viral_inactivation"]["none"]
vi_none_phrase = (f"for any of its {nw(n_vi_factors)} parameters" if n_vi_none == n_vi_factors
                  else f"for {nw(n_vi_none)} of its {nw(n_vi_factors)} parameters")
vi_ph_v1 = par_cell("viral_inactivation", "XMuLV LRF (log₁₀)", "Inactivation pH", 1)
vi_xm_v1 = _r1("viral_inactivation", "xmulv_lrf")["low"]
vi_xm_v2 = D.iac_limit("viral_inactivation", "xmulv_lrf")[0]
assert vi_xm_v2 > vi_xm_v1

assert len(_an) == _ps["aex"]["narrower"] and bool(_an["CQA"].str.contains("LRF").all())
assert set(_an["Parameter"]) == {"Load pH"}
aex_narrow_txt = " and ".join(f"{l.split(' ')[0]} from {o} to {n}" for l, o, n in
                              zip(_an["CQA"], _an["PAR (NOR)_v1"], _an["PAR (NOR)"]))
assert all(_r1("aex", r)["low"] < D.iac_limit("aex", r)[0] for r in ["xmulv_lrf", "mvm_lrf"])

# CAPA and effectiveness check, from config campaign.capa
# every action has the same status at closure, so the table states it once, in its caption
assert CAPA["status"].nunique() == 1
capa_status = CAPA["status"].iloc[0]
capa_md = CAPA.drop(columns=["status"]).rename(columns={"id": "No.", "action": "Action",
                                                        "owner": "Owner function", "due": "Due"})
_ca = CAPA[CAPA["id"].str.startswith("CA")]
_pa = CAPA[CAPA["id"].str.startswith("PA")]
ca_open_due = _ca["due"].max()
assert ca_open_due == REV2_DATE
n_capa = len(CAPA)
assert capa_status == "open at closure"
pa_due_max = _pa["due"].max()
# of the preventive actions, only PA1 revises SOP-1002 (the Summary names it)
assert list(_pa[_pa["action"].str.contains("SOP-1002")]["id"]) == ["PA1"]
eff_due, eff_crit = EFFECTIVENESS["due"], EFFECTIVENESS["criterion"]

# capability thresholds stated in PCMP-001 Version 2.0
_below = capdf[capdf["Cpk"] < CPK_TARGET]
n_below_target = len(_below)
all_meet_min = bool((capdf["Cpk"] >= CPK_MIN).all())
_below_names = " and ".join(aname(k) for k in _below.index)
thr_sentence = ((f"Only the capability index of {_below_names} falls below the target" if n_below_target == 1
                 else f"The capability indices of {_below_names} fall below the target") if n_below_target
                else "Every attribute meets the target") + (
    ", and every attribute meets the minimum." if all_meet_min else
    ", and at least one attribute falls below the minimum.")

# each re-analysed pool attribute and clearance result against its Version 2.0 criterion over the
# NOR, at manufacturing scale, on the response-surface model (one basis for Tables 6.4 and 6.5)
def _lf_txt(k, combo):
    """The least favourable NOR combination, written out: 'inactivation pH at its NOR high (3.6)'."""
    uo = CFG.unit_op(k)
    parts = []
    for f, v in combo.items():
        p = uo.param(f)
        where = "NOR low" if v == p.nor[0] else "NOR high" if v == p.nor[1] else "set-point"
        u = "" if p.unit == "pH" else f" {p.unit}"
        parts.append(f"{lc(p.name)} at its {where} ({v:g}{u})")
    return ", ".join(parts[:-1]) + " and " + parts[-1] if len(parts) > 1 else parts[0]

_res = []
for _, r in _iac.iterrows():
    k, resp = r["step_key"], r["response"]
    uo = CFG.unit_op(k)
    fac = D.fit(k, "rsm", resp)["factors"]
    grid = list(itertools.product(*[[uo.param(f).nor[0], uo.param(f).setpoint, uo.param(f).nor[1]] for f in fac]))
    nat = {f: [g[i] for g in grid] for i, f in enumerate(fac)}
    spn = {f: [uo.param(f).setpoint] for f in fac}
    _o = D.sdm_offset(k, resp)
    off = 0.0 if _o is None else _o["offset"]
    stat = D.decision_statistic(resp)
    mean = np.asarray(D.predict(k, resp, natural=nat), float) - off
    sp = float(D.predict(k, resp, natural=spn)[0]) - off
    lo_c, hi_c, st = r["iac_low"], r["iac_high"], r["spec_type"]
    if stat == "batch":
        _, plo, phi = D.prediction_interval(k, resp, nat)
        lo_v, hi_v = float(plo.min()) - off, float(phi.max()) - off
        _, splo, sphi = D.prediction_interval(k, resp, spn)
        sp_ok = _in(float(splo[0]) - off, lo_c, hi_c, st) and _in(float(sphi[0]) - off, lo_c, hi_c, st)
        i_bad = int(np.argmin(plo)) if not _in(lo_v, lo_c, hi_c, st) else int(np.argmax(phi))
    else:
        assert st == "lower"
        lo_v, hi_v = float(mean.min()), float(mean.max())
        sp_ok = _in(sp, lo_c, hi_c, st)
        i_bad = int(np.argmin(mean))
    ok = D.nor_met(k, resp)
    assert ok == (_in(lo_v, lo_c, hi_c, st) and _in(hi_v, lo_c, hi_c, st)), (k, resp)
    _res.append(dict(step=k, cqa=r["cqa"], resp=resp, crit=T.crit(lo_c, hi_c, st), stat=stat,
                     sp=sp, lo=lo_v, hi=hi_v, ok=ok, sp_ok=sp_ok, off=off,
                     lo_c=lo_c, hi_c=hi_c, st=st, corner=dict(zip(fac, grid[i_bad]))))
res_df = pd.DataFrame(_res)
qa_df = res_df[res_df["stat"] == "batch"].reset_index(drop=True)
vir_df = res_df[res_df["stat"] == "worst_case"].reset_index(drop=True)
assert set(vir_df["cqa"]) <= {"lrv_xmulv", "lrv_mvm"} and len(vir_df) == n_iac_claim
res_show = pd.DataFrame({
    "Step": [T.STEP_NAME[s] for s in qa_df["step"]],
    "Attribute": [T.ATTR_NAME[c] for c in qa_df["cqa"]],
    "Criterion": qa_df["crit"],
    "Mean at set-points": [T.num(x) for x in qa_df["sp"]],
    "95 % prediction interval over the NOR": [f"{T.num(a)} to {T.num(b)}" for a, b in zip(qa_df["lo"], qa_df["hi"])],
    "Met": ["Met" if o else "Not met" for o in qa_df["ok"]],
})
viral_show = pd.DataFrame({
    "Step": [T.STEP_NAME[s] for s in vir_df["step"]],
    "Virus": ["XMuLV" if c == "lrv_xmulv" else "MVM" for c in vir_df["cqa"]],
    "Claim": [T.crit(lo, hi, st) for lo, hi, st in zip(vir_df["lo_c"], vir_df["hi_c"], vir_df["st"])],
    "At set-points": [f2(x) for x in vir_df["sp"]],
    "At the LFC": [f2(x) for x in vir_df["lo"]],
    "Met": ["Met" if o else "Not met" for o in vir_df["ok"]],
})
n_qa, n_qa_met = len(qa_df), int(qa_df["ok"].sum())
n_vir, n_vir_met = len(vir_df), int(vir_df["ok"].sum())
n_vir_sp_met = int(vir_df["sp_ok"].sum())
n_res, n_res_met = len(res_df), int(res_df["ok"].sum())
n_res_not = n_res - n_res_met
_nm = res_df[~res_df["ok"]]
assert bool(_nm["sp_ok"].all())                      # each not-met result is met with every parameter at its set-point
def _nm_name(r): return f"{aname(r['cqa'])} at the {sname(r['step'])} step"
nm_list = " and ".join(_nm_name(r) for _, r in _nm.iterrows())
_qnm = qa_df[~qa_df["ok"]]
qa_phrase = (f"Every one of the {n_qa} pool attributes meets its criterion across the NOR." if len(_qnm) == 0 else
             f"Of the {n_qa} pool attributes, {n_qa_met} meet their criterion across the NOR.")

# acidic variants at the bioreactor, the one pool attribute not met: the corner of the NOR where its
# lower prediction limit is lowest, and the direction of each effect in this campaign's model and in
# the scaled estimates of the published A-Mab case study (Table 3.16), which the config carries as
# the coefficients of the bioreactor model
assert list(zip(_qnm["step"], _qnm["cqa"])) == [("bioreactor", "acidic_variants")]
_qa_r = _qnm.iloc[0]
assert not _in(_qa_r["lo"], _qa_r["lo_c"], _qa_r["hi_c"], _qa_r["st"]) and _qa_r["sp_ok"]
acid_lpl, acid_lo_c = _qa_r["lo"], _qa_r["lo_c"]
_ac = D.rsm_coeff_df("bioreactor", "acidic_variants").set_index("Term")
_al = D.factor_letters("bioreactor")
_pub = CFG.raw()["process"]["bioreactor"]["rsm"]["linear"]["acidic_variants"]
_ALPHA = THRESHOLDS["effect_alpha"]
_bu = CFG.unit_op("bioreactor")
def _terms(f): return [t for t in _ac.index if t != "Intercept" and _al[f] in t]
_corner = _qa_r["corner"]
acid_sig = [f for f in _corner if any(_ac.loc[t, "p-value"] < _ALPHA for t in _terms(f))]
acid_nsig = [f for f in _corner if f not in acid_sig]
for f in acid_sig:
    _c = float(_ac.loc[_al[f], "Coef."])
    assert _ac.loc[_al[f], "p-value"] < _ALPHA and _c * _pub[f] > 0     # same direction as the case study
    assert _corner[f] == (_bu.param(f).nor[1] if _c < 0 else _bu.param(f).nor[0])   # the end that lowers them
def _pn(f): return lc(_bu.param(f).name)
def _pv(f): return f"{_corner[f]:g}" + ("" if _bu.param(f).unit == "pH" else f" {_bu.param(f).unit}")
def _and(xs): return ", ".join(xs[:-1]) + " and " + xs[-1] if len(xs) > 1 else xs[0]
def _end(f):
    p = _bu.param(f)
    return "upper end" if _corner[f] == p.nor[1] else "lower end" if _corner[f] == p.nor[0] else "set-point"
def _at(fs, end):
    if len(fs) == 1:
        return f"{_pn(fs[0])} is at its {end} ({_pv(fs[0])})"
    return f"{_and([_pn(f) for f in fs])} are at their {end}s ({_and([_pv(f) for f in fs])})"
_ups = [f for f in acid_sig if _end(f) == "upper end"]
_los = [f for f in acid_sig if _end(f) == "lower end"]
assert sorted(_ups + _los) == sorted(acid_sig) and _ups and _los
acid_corner_txt = _at(_ups, "upper end") + " and " + _at(_los, "lower end")
_fall = [f for f in acid_sig if _ac.loc[_al[f], "Coef."] < 0]
_rise = [f for f in acid_sig if _ac.loc[_al[f], "Coef."] > 0]
assert _fall and _rise
acid_dir_txt = (_and(["higher " + _pn(f) for f in _fall]) + " lower acidic variants, and "
                + _and(["higher " + _pn(f) for f in _rise]) + (" raises" if len(_rise) == 1 else " raise") + " them")
assert acid_nsig and all(_end(f) != "set-point" for f in acid_nsig)
acid_nsig_txt = " ".join(f"{_pn(f)[0].upper() + _pn(f)[1:]} is at its {_end(f)} ({_pv(f)}) at that corner, but it "
                         "has no significant effect on acidic variants in the model." for f in acid_nsig)

# acidic variants at the bioreactor: which proven acceptable range no longer covers its NOR, and why
_bpt = D.par_table("bioreactor")
_bpa = _bpt[_bpt["CQA"] == "Acidic variants"]
_unc = []
for _, r in _bpa.iterrows():
    f = [x for x in D.rsm_factors("bioreactor") if CFG.unit_op("bioreactor").param(x).name == r["Parameter"]][0]
    p = CFG.unit_op("bioreactor").param(f)
    a, b = _span(r["PAR (NOR)"])
    if a > p.nor[0] or b < p.nor[1]:
        _unc.append((f, p, a, b, r["Unit"]))
assert len(_unc) == 1
_uf, _up, _ua, _ub, _uu = _unc[0]
acid_unc_name, acid_unc_par = lc(_up.name), f"{_ua:g}–{_ub:g}"
acid_unc_unit, acid_unc_nor_hi = _uu, _up.nor[1]
assert _ub < _up.nor[1] and _ua <= _up.nor[0]           # the range stops short of the upper NOR edge
_acoef = D.rsm_coeff_df("bioreactor", "acidic_variants").set_index("Term")["Coef."]
acid_unc_coef = float(_acoef[D.factor_letters("bioreactor")[_uf]])
assert acid_unc_coef < 0 and _pub[_uf] < 0              # acidic variants fall as this parameter rises, as in the case study
assert _uf in acid_sig

# XMuLV clearance of low-pH viral inactivation at the least favourable combination
_rx = vir_df[(vir_df["step"] == "viral_inactivation") & (vir_df["cqa"] == "lrv_xmulv")].iloc[0]
vi_xm_worst, vi_xm_sp, vi_xm_ok = _rx["lo"], _rx["sp"], bool(_rx["ok"])
assert not vi_xm_ok and _rx["sp_ok"]
vi_corner_txt = _lf_txt("viral_inactivation", _rx["corner"])
vir_phrase = ((f"With every parameter at its set-point, every one of the {n_vir} claims is met."
               if n_vir_sp_met == n_vir else
               f"With every parameter at its set-point, {n_vir_sp_met} of the {n_vir} claims are met.")
              + (f" At the least favourable combination, every claim is met." if n_vir_met == n_vir else
                 f" At the least favourable combination, {n_vir_met} of the {n_vir} claims are met."))

# leached Protein A at the capture step, judged per batch at manufacturing scale
_rl = qa_df[(qa_df["step"] == "protein_a") & (qa_df["cqa"] == "leached_protein_a")].iloc[0]
lpa_sp, lpa_hi, lpa_crit = _rl["sp"], _rl["hi"], _rl["hi_c"]
ds_lpa = _ds("leached_protein_a", "ds_high")
assert bool(_rl["ok"]) and lpa_hi > ds_lpa
lpa_need = lpa_hi / ds_lpa                               # downstream clearance the batch needs
lpa_assumed = float(_iac[(_iac["step_key"] == "protein_a") & (_iac["cqa"] == "leached_protein_a")].iloc[0]["downstream_fold"])
assert lpa_need < lpa_assumed
_lv = ver[ver["cqa"] == "leached_protein_a"]
assert len(_lv) == 2 and bool(_lv["met"].isna().all())
assert bool(_lv["predicted_nor"].isna().all())          # "not a response" in the verification table

# (Protein A pool host cell protein, the pool attribute nearest its criterion, is stated at the end of
# this chunk on the log-scale model that PCR-005 Version 2.0 uses)

# the tightened aggregate criteria: did any proven acceptable range at those steps stop short?
def _full(key, lbl_prefix):
    t = D.par_table(key)
    t = t[t["CQA"].str.startswith(lbl_prefix)]
    return all(_span(a) == _span(b) for a, b in zip(t["PAR (NOR)"], t["Char. range"]))
tight_full = all(_full(k, "Aggregates") for k in _tt["step_key"])
tight_phrase = ("Against the tightened criteria, every aggregate proven acceptable range at these two steps "
                "still spans the whole characterization range, so the tightening moved no range."
                if tight_full else
                "Against the tightened criteria, at least one aggregate proven acceptable range at these steps "
                "no longer spans the whole characterization range.")

# the bioreactor aggregate criterion, both tightened and widened
_both = _iac[_is_t & _is_w]
n_both = len(_both)
both_txt = " and ".join(f"{aname(c)} at the {sname(s)} step" for s, c in zip(_both["step_key"], _both["cqa"]))
assert n_both == 1 and _both.iloc[0]["step_key"] == "bioreactor" and _both.iloc[0]["cqa"] == "aggregates_hmw"
_vagg = ver[(ver["step_key"] == "viral_inactivation") & (ver["cqa"] == "aggregates_hmw")].iloc[0]
assert bool(_vagg["widening_supported"])
vi_agg_assumed, vi_agg_bound = _vagg["assumed"], _vagg["predicted_nor_bound95"]
cex_agg_bound = _vx["predicted_nor_bound95"]
assert cex_agg_bound < cex_agg_assumed
# the bioreactor acidic variant criterion is not widened: the low-pH acidic-variant model is an exact fit,
# so its bound cannot replace the platform value (owner, 2026-10-09)
_vacid = ver[(ver["step_key"] == "viral_inactivation") & (ver["cqa"] == "acidic_variants")].iloc[0]
assert not bool(_vacid["widening_supported"]) and not bool(_vacid["model_adequate"])
vi_acid_assumed, vi_acid_bound = _vacid["assumed"], _vacid["predicted_nor_bound95"]
assert vi_acid_bound < vi_acid_assumed
_wvi = _iac[_is_w & (_iac["step_key"] == "bioreactor")]
assert set(_wvi["cqa"]) == {"aggregates_hmw"}                         # the one widened at the bioreactor
# The platform values of the low-pH hold are increases over a longer hold than A-Mab's NOR allows: the
# A-Mab values are increases within the NOR as characterized. Why each criterion moved differs by
# attribute (PCP-006 factual check, 2026-10-09). The edges of the range studied include the platform's
# hold. Where A-Mab adds at least the platform value there, the criterion moved because the A-Mab hold is
# shorter. Where it adds less even there, A-Mab also adds less over the same hold.
import re as _re
_plat = CFG.raw()["iac"]["platform"]["viral_inactivation"]
_hold = {c: int(_re.search(r"hold, (\d+) min", _plat[c]["source"]).group(1))
         for c in ["aggregates_hmw", "acidic_variants"]}
assert len(set(_hold.values())) == 1
plat_hold_min = next(iter(_hold.values()))
amab_hold_max = CFG.unit_op("viral_inactivation").param("hold_time").nor_characterized[1]
assert amab_hold_max < plat_hold_min
assert CFG.unit_op("viral_inactivation").param("hold_time").prange[1] >= plat_hold_min   # the edges include it
_vi_why = []
for _c, _w in [(c, w) for c, w in [("aggregates_hmw", "aggregate"), ("acidic_variants", "acidic variants")]
               if c in set(_wvi["cqa"])]:
    _r = ver[(ver["step_key"] == "viral_inactivation") & (ver["cqa"] == _c)].iloc[0]
    if _r["observed_edge"] >= _r["assumed"]:
        _vi_why.append(f"For {_w}, the largest increase measured at the edges of the range studied, which include "
                       f"a hold of {plat_hold_min} min, is {f2(_r['observed_edge'])} points, above the platform value. "
                       f"That criterion therefore moved because the A-Mab hold is shorter, not because A-Mab is more "
                       f"stable at low pH.")
    else:
        _vi_why.append(f"For {_w}, the largest increase measured at the edges of the range studied is "
                       f"{f2(_r['observed_edge'])} points, below the platform value even over a hold of {plat_hold_min} "
                       f"min. A-Mab therefore adds less than the platform products over the same hold, and its shorter "
                       f"hold lowers the increase further.")
vi_why_text = " ".join(_vi_why)

# "No range" rows are all viral clearance, judged at the least favourable combination
assert bool(allpar[allpar["kind"] == "none"]["CQA"].str.contains("LRF").all())

# the SEC excess against the Protein A fragment criterion
pa_frag_crit = D.iac_limit("protein_a", "lmw_cesds_pct")[1]
sec_share_crit = 100 * d_pa / pa_frag_crit

# acidic variants capability: distance of the mean from each limit, in SD
acid_z_lo, acid_z_hi = (acid_mean - ds_acid_lo) / acid_sd, (ds_acid_hi - acid_mean) / acid_sd
assert acid_z_lo < acid_z_hi

# data the re-analysis adds to those Version 1.0 reported: the fragment results by nrCE-SDS of the
# designed experiments, measured in the design itself or in a retest of its retained samples
_retest_ids = list(ret_ids)
retest_txt = " and ".join(_retest_ids)
_mp = csv("method_plan.csv")
_ce = _mp[_mp["lmw_cesds"].astype(bool) & _mp["kind"].isin(["screening", "rsm"])]
assert bool((_ce["end"] < REV1_DATE).all())                 # measured before Version 1.0 was approved
_ret_steps = list(chron[chron["kind"] == "retest"]["step"])
_sup_steps = set(chron[chron["kind"] == "superseded"]["step"])
_ce_where = []
for _k, _g in _ce.groupby("step", sort=False):
    if _k in _ret_steps:
        assert list(_g["kind"]) == ["rsm"]                  # the retests cover the response surface samples
        continue
    _kinds = set(_g["kind"])
    _ce_where.append(("the re-executed " if _k in _sup_steps else "the ") + sname(_k)
                     + (" design" if _kinds == {"screening", "rsm"} else
                        " response surface study" if _kinds == {"rsm"} else " screening study"))
assert set(_ret_steps) <= set(_ce["step"])
ce_where_txt = "in " + ", in ".join(_ce_where) + f" and in the retests of retained samples ({retest_txt})"
# the steps with a fragment criterion, each judged on nrCE-SDS results of its response surface study
_fs = _iac[_iac["cqa"] == "fragments_lmw"].sort_values("step")
assert set(_fs["step_key"]) == set(_ce[_ce["kind"] == "rsm"]["step"])
_fn = [sname(k) for k in _fs["step_key"]]
frag_steps_txt = ", ".join(_fn[:-1]) + " and " + _fn[-1]

# Version 1.0 alert-limit ranges at the bioreactor that stopped short of the NOR (finding F3)
_r2 = allpar[(allpar["step"] == "bioreactor") & allpar["CQA"].isin(["Afucosylation", "Galactosylation", "High mannose"])]
_short = 0
for _, r in _r2.iterrows():
    f = [x for x in D.rsm_factors("bioreactor") if CFG.unit_op("bioreactor").param(x).name == r["Parameter"]][0]
    p = CFG.unit_op("bioreactor").param(f); a, b = _span(r["PAR (NOR)_v1"])
    _short += int(a > p.nor[0] or b < p.nor[1])
assert _short >= 2                                       # "several" stopped short of the NOR
par_align = ["l", "P{3.4cm}"] + ["r"] * (par_show.shape[1] - 2)
par_notes = [n for n, c in [(("a)", "One end of the range moved inward and the other outward."), "Moved"),
                            (("b)", "With the other parameters at their least favourable combination of NOR low, set-point and NOR high, the viral clearance claim is not met even with the scanned parameter at its set-point."), "No range"),
                            (("c)", "Fragment ranges measured by nrCE-SDS, which Version 1.0 did not report."), "New")]
             if c in par_show.columns]
# close the Version 1.0 models; assigned, so the cell does not echo the return value
_pf_closed = _PF.__exit__(None, None, None)

# --- On the models INV-002 corrective action CA3 selects (the models of PCR-005 and PCR-006 Version 2.0,
# and of the verification behind the criteria), still at the NOR as characterized ---
# The Protein A scale-down model (plan discrepancy PD-005-01): offset and qualification of each output with
# a criterion, on the planned runs alone and on all runs
_sdm_sets = {"planned": _sdm_planned_ids, "all": None}
_q = {s: T.sdm_offsets_data(["protein_a"], studies=ids).set_index("output") for s, ids in _sdm_sets.items()}
_qj = _q["planned"].index[_q["planned"]["judged"].astype(bool)].tolist()
assert _qj == _q["all"].index[_q["all"]["judged"].astype(bool)].tolist() and "pool_hcp_ng_mg" in _qj
def _oname(o):
    n = T.SDM_OUTPUT[o][0]
    return n.replace("Leached", "leached") if n.startswith("Leached") else lc(n)
assert set(_qj) == {"pool_hcp_ng_mg", "leached_protein_a_ppm"}
# leached Protein A: the model is qualified on either set of runs
for _s in _q:
    _r = _q[_s].loc["leached_protein_a_ppm"]
    assert all(bool(_r[c]) for c in ["qualified", "met_point", "met_lo", "met_hi"]), _s
lpa_oname = _oname("leached_protein_a_ppm")
# pool host cell protein, over the NOR as characterized: met with the offset at its estimate, but not with
# the ratio at the low end of its interval (which raises the prediction at manufacturing scale), so the
# model is not qualified there, on either set of runs
for _s in _q:
    _r = _q[_s].loc["pool_hcp_ng_mg"]
    assert bool(_r["met_point"]) and bool(_r["met_hi"]) and not bool(_r["met_lo"]) and not bool(_r["qualified"]), _s
# pool host cell protein is modelled on the log scale, so its offset is a ratio of geometric means
assert D.fit("protein_a", "rsm", "pool_hcp_ng_mg")["transform"] == "log"
_hq = {s: D.offset_qualification("protein_a", "pool_hcp_ng_mg", studies=ids) for s, ids in _sdm_sets.items()}
assert all(q["scale"] == "ratio" for q in _hq.values())
assert _hq["all"]["half"] < _hq["planned"]["half"]            # the further runs narrowed the interval
def f3(x): return f"{x:.3f}"
pa_r_plan, pa_r_plan_lo, pa_r_plan_hi = (f3(_hq["planned"][c]) for c in ["offset", "lo", "hi"])
pa_r_all, pa_r_all_lo, pa_r_all_hi = (f3(_hq["all"][c]) for c in ["offset", "lo", "hi"])
# the upper 95 % prediction limit over the NOR as characterized, with the ratio at the low end of its
# interval (all runs): above the criterion
with D.offset_at("lo"):
    pa_upl_char_lo = D.nor_prediction_limit("protein_a", "pool_hcp_ng_mg")
assert pa_upl_char_lo > pa_hcp_v2
# how near each Protein A pool attribute comes to its criterion: the upper 95 % prediction limit over the
# NOR at manufacturing scale (divided by the ratio offset on the log-scale model), against the criterion
_pa_use = {}
for _, r in _iac[_iac["step_key"] == "protein_a"].iterrows():
    assert r["spec_type"] == "upper" and D.decision_statistic(r["response"]) == "batch"
    assert D.model_status("protein_a", r["response"]) == "selected"
    _pa_use[r["cqa"]] = D.nor_prediction_limit("protein_a", r["response"]) / float(r["iac_high"])
assert max(_pa_use, key=_pa_use.get) == "hcp"                 # host cell protein comes nearest its criterion
pa_hcp_use = 100 * _pa_use["hcp"]
_hc = D.rsm_coeff_df("protein_a", "pool_hcp_ng_mg").set_index("Term")["Coef."]
_hl = D.factor_letters("protein_a")
_mains = sorted(((abs(float(_hc[_hl[f]])), f, float(_hc[_hl[f]])) for f in D.rsm_factors("protein_a")
                 if _hl[f] in _hc.index), reverse=True)[:2]
assert len(_mains) == 2
pa_hcp_drivers = " and ".join(("higher " if c > 0 else "lower ") + lc(CFG.unit_op("protein_a").param(f).name)
                              for _, f, c in _mains)
# XMuLV clearance of low-pH viral inactivation on its selected model: the claim is not met at the least
# favourable combination of the NOR as characterized
assert D.model_status("viral_inactivation", "xmulv_lrf") == "selected"
vi_sel_met_char = D.nor_met("viral_inactivation", "xmulv_lrf")
assert vi_sel_met_char is False

# close the characterized-NOR context: from here on, the NOR and set-points in force at Version 2.0
_cn_closed = _CN.__exit__(None, None, None)

# the Version 2.0 NOR and set-point decisions (config nor_v2 and setpoint_v2), classified per parameter
def _nor_change(p):
    a, b = [float(x) for x in p.nor_characterized], [float(x) for x in p.nor]
    s0, s1 = float(p.setpoint_characterized), float(p.setpoint)
    eq = lambda x, y: abs(x - y) < 1e-9
    if eq(a[0], b[0]) and eq(a[1], b[1]):
        nor = None
    elif eq(b[1] - b[0], a[1] - a[0]):
        nor = "moved lower" if b[0] < a[0] else "moved higher"
    elif b[0] >= a[0] - 1e-9 and b[1] <= a[1] + 1e-9:
        nor = ("narrowed at its low end" if eq(b[1], a[1]) else
               "narrowed at its high end" if eq(b[0], a[0]) else "narrowed at both ends")
    else:
        nor = "widened"
    if eq(s0, s1):
        sp = None
    elif nor and nor.startswith("moved") and eq(s1 - s0, b[0] - a[0]):
        sp = "with the NOR"
    elif eq(s1, (b[0] + b[1]) / 2):
        sp = "to the middle of the new NOR"
    else:
        sp = "within the NOR"
    return dict(key=p.key, name=lc(p.name), unit=p.unit, old=a, new=b, s0=s0, s1=s1, nor=nor, sp=sp)
def _nor_changes(k):
    return [c for c in (_nor_change(p) for p in CFG.unit_op(k).parameters) if c["nor"] or c["sp"]]
def _vrng(lo, hi, unit): return f"{lo:g}–{hi:g}" + ("" if unit == "pH" else f" {unit}")
# "the process is unchanged except for NORs at these steps and set-points at these" (§6.6)
_nor_steps = [k for k in CFG.train_order if any(c["nor"] for c in _nor_changes(k))]
_sp_steps = [k for k in CFG.train_order if any(c["sp"] for c in _nor_changes(k))]
assert _nor_steps == ["protein_a", "viral_inactivation"] and _sp_steps == ["viral_inactivation"]
proc_nor_steps, proc_sp_steps = _and([sname(k) for k in _nor_steps]), _and([sname(k) for k in _sp_steps])

# Protein A (PCR-005 Version 2.0): the protein load NOR narrowed, set-point unchanged
_pa_ch = _nor_changes("protein_a")
assert len(_pa_ch) == 1 and _pa_ch[0]["nor"].startswith("narrowed") and not _pa_ch[0]["sp"]
_pl_ = _pa_ch[0]
pa_nor_summary = f"narrows the NOR of {_pl_['name']}"
pa_nor_txt = (f"{pa_nor_summary} {_pl_['nor'][len('narrowed '):]}, from "
              f"{_vrng(*_pl_['old'], _pl_['unit'])} to {_vrng(*_pl_['new'], _pl_['unit'])}")
# over the narrowed NOR the scale-down model is qualified for pool host cell protein on all runs, and it
# would not be on the planned runs alone: the further runs made the qualification possible
_hqf = {s: D.offset_qualification("protein_a", "pool_hcp_ng_mg", studies=ids) for s, ids in _sdm_sets.items()}
assert _hqf["all"]["qualified"] and not _hqf["planned"]["qualified"] and not _hqf["planned"]["met_lo"]
with D.offset_at("lo"):
    pa_upl_force_lo = D.nor_prediction_limit("protein_a", "pool_hcp_ng_mg")
with D.offset_at("lo", _sdm_planned_ids):
    pa_upl_force_lo_plan = D.nor_prediction_limit("protein_a", "pool_hcp_ng_mg")
assert pa_upl_force_lo <= pa_hcp_v2 < pa_upl_force_lo_plan
# leached Protein A stays qualified over the narrowed NOR, on either set of runs
assert all(D.offset_qualification("protein_a", "leached_protein_a_ppm", studies=ids)["qualified"]
           for ids in _sdm_sets.values())

# low-pH viral inactivation (PCR-006 Version 2.0). The investigation states the direction of each change
# and no value: PCR-006 revised the hold time after this investigation closed, and gives the values
_vi_ch = _nor_changes("viral_inactivation")
assert _vi_ch and all(c["nor"] and c["nor"] != "widened" for c in _vi_ch)
# every changed parameter acts on XMuLV clearance in its selected model
assert {c["key"] for c in _vi_ch} <= set(D.fit("viral_inactivation", "rsm", "xmulv_lrf")["names"])
_mv = [c for c in _vi_ch if c["nor"].startswith("moved")]
_nr = [c for c in _vi_ch if c["nor"].startswith("narrowed")]
assert _mv and _nr and len({c["nor"] for c in _mv}) == 1
_dir = _mv[0]["nor"].split()[1]
# each moved NOR takes its set-point with it, in the same direction
assert all(c["sp"] and ((c["s1"] < c["s0"]) == (_dir == "lower")) for c in _mv)
vi_nor_summary = (f"moves the NOR{'s' if len(_mv) > 1 else ''} and the set-point{'s' if len(_mv) > 1 else ''} "
                  f"of {_and([c['name'] for c in _mv])} {_dir} and narrows the NOR{'s' if len(_nr) > 1 else ''} "
                  f"of {_and([c['name'] for c in _nr])}")
# the hold-time NOR in force reaches no further than the hold the verification of §6.2 covered
assert CFG.unit_op("viral_inactivation").param("hold_time").nor[1] <= amab_hold_max

inv2_id, inv2_opened = INV2["id"], INV2["opened"]
assert OPENED < inv2_opened < CLOSED                       # INV-002 was opened during this investigation
# INV-002 corrective action CA3 (model selection) was adopted before this investigation closed, so the
# verification behind the criteria fixed at closure used the selected models
sel_adopted = CFG.raw()["campaign"]["model_adequacy"]["selection_adopted"]
assert inv2_opened < sel_adopted < CLOSED
```

# Summary {.unnumbered}

On `{python} OPENED`, Quality Assurance opened this investigation, `{python} DOC`, during the review of the Process Characterization Master Report PCMR-001 Version 1.0 for BLA readiness. The review found that the acceptance criteria against which each step was judged in the proven acceptable range analysis were not in any protocol approved before the studies ran. They had been set at analysis time, after the data were known. The investigation was classified as `{python} INV["classification"]`.

The investigation makes six findings, numbered F1 to F6 in §4. Four concern the criteria themselves. The criteria were defined after the data were seen (F1). For impurities that downstream steps clear, each criterion was divided by a safety factor that differed by step, and the factors were such that every step passed at its own set-point (F2). The glycan and acidic variant limits at the bioreactor were computed from the capability data they were then used to judge (F3). Acidic variants were assessed against the upper end of their two-sided range only (F4). Finding F5 concerns the records. Their title blocks misstated the dates on which the plans were approved, and they gave no execution dates. Finding F6 concerns the method for fragments. SEC read fragments high in the Protein A pool and the low-pH viral inactivation pool, and the decision `{python} AMD["id"]` to measure fragments by nrCE-SDS instead was not carried into the documents.

The root cause is that the Process Characterization Master Plan PCMP-001 Version 1.0 required a criterion for each step but gave no rule for deriving one. The criteria were therefore derived during the analysis, by the people analysing the data (§5).

Under corrective action CA1, the investigation defined intermediate acceptance criteria by a rule written before any report applied it. Each criterion is carried back from the drug-substance criterion through the platform worst case of each downstream step, with no margin. This campaign's data can move a criterion only through the one-sided `{python} VB` % prediction bound of a single batch of a downstream step, at the least favourable combination within its normal operating range (NOR). The same rule set fixes how a scale-down model whose mean differs from manufacturing scale is qualified, and that viral clearance is judged at the least favourable combination of the other parameters. Corrective action CA1 issues all of this in PCMP-001 Version 2.0. Corrective actions CA2 and CA3 reissue the step plans and every other document of the package against it, with fragments measured by nrCE-SDS. They are due on `{python} ca_open_due` and were open at closure. Preventive action PA1 revises SOP-1002 so that a characterization protocol cannot be approved without its criteria (§7).

Of the `{python} n_par_v1` proven acceptable ranges that Version 1.0 reported with the other parameters varying within their NORs, `{python} par_counts_phrase`. In the re-analysis, `{python} nm_list` do not meet their Version 2.0 criterion across the whole NOR, although each meets it with every parameter at its set-point (§6.3). At Version 2.0, the Protein A report PCR-005 `{python} pa_nor_summary`, because over the NOR as it was characterized the scale-down model is not qualified for pool host cell protein (§2). The low-pH viral inactivation report PCR-006 `{python} vi_nor_summary`, because XMuLV clearance does not meet its claim at the least favourable combination of the NOR as it was characterized (§6.3). The lowest capability index of the drug substance is now that of acidic variants, at `{python} f2(v2_min_cpk)`, against its lower limit. No GMP batch was dispositioned on these documents, and there is no product impact (§6.6).

# Scope

The investigation covers the `{python} n_docs_v1` Version 1.0 documents of the A-Mab characterization package, listed in @tbl-docs. Within them it covers four subjects. Under `{python} inv2_id` corrective action CA3, adopted on `{python} sel_adopted`, before this investigation closed, every response-surface output is analysed by model selection, and `{python} inv2_id` gives the procedure. The verification of the platform worst cases in §6.2, on which the Version 2.0 criteria rest, used these selected models. print()
